name: Encounter Pressure & Difficulty-Shaping Library Contract
purpose: Translate PPIA-11/F012 encounter factors into explicit, uncertainty-aware GM-facing pressure-shaping proposals without a universal difficulty scalar or balance guarantee.
blocking_invariants: No universal CR, encounter level, difficulty score, threat number, weighted sum or cross-domain power scalar.
No balanced, fair, safe, winnable, optimal or guaranteed label.
Unknown/source-unspecified values remain unknown; indeterminate is valid.
Every recommendation names the specific pressure dimension and explicit proposed delta.
Recommendations may shape existing governed participants, timing, environment, objectives, resources, information and waves but may not invent source mechanics.
Difficulty changes must expose material tradeoffs into other pressure dimensions.
Approval, simulation, comparison and Scene attachment remain F012/PPIA-11 operations.
